messages:
Sam: Kicking off tonight's change window — targets: API v2.4 (stable), runtime v5.1 (perf kernels), router header-split. Need a clear pin/unpin sequence + rollback criteria. Who's on-call for console schema?
Marta: I'm on console. Heads-up: small schema PR (adds route metadata) is in draft; we can merge after api->runtime go green, but console deploy must happen before unpin.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] scheduled deployment: 1771238200 -> canary rollout to 5% then 25 then 100%. Release ticket: #INF-1428.
Jules: Quick Q: do we have a compatible runtime image for the router header-split? Last time there was a mismatch and KV eviction sky-rocketed.
Priya: Runtime v5.1 includes the header-split patchset and the eviction backoff fix. Confirmed by perf team in staging.
Ben: Order proposal: 1) runtime (scale canary 5%) 2) router (canary 5%, rely on runtime new kernels) 3) API (thin rollout) 4) console (schema forward-merge, small deploy) 5) unpin. Thoughts?
Sam: That order works. Add a short pause after runtime canary to validate p95 and kv-miss rates.
Jules: Rollback criteria suggestion: any of the following within a 5m sustained window => rollback: 
- error rate increase > 2.5% absolute (user-facing 5xx)
- p95 latency increase > 200ms and relative +30%
- KV miss rate > baseline + 12%
Keep it conservative for runtime change.
Priya: +1. Also add model-serving token error spike (for hosted customers) as a trigger.
Marta: Console constraint: we must merge schema PR before console deploy. I'll aim to merge at t+30m after API steady. If schema merge delayed, console should be held and we keep API pinned.
Sam: Canary cadence: runtime 5% for 10m, expand to 25% for 15m, then router 5% for 10m, expand if metrics good. Deploy-bot will run the waves.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] executing: 
```
# runtime canary wave
deploy run --service runtime --image rwd/runtime:v5.1-canary --percent 5 --meta "canary=release-1771234567"
```
Jules: Logging hooks to watch: runtime.evictions, infra.kv_miss_rate, api.user_5xx, router.header_split_errors. Set alert thresholds beforehand.
Ben: Release notes checklist: PR for release notes (link: https://git/repo/pulls/214), rollout doc updated, rollback playbook updated, stakeholders pinged (support, security, enterprise customers list).
Sam: I'll ping support + enterprise slack channel once API at 25% steady.
Priya: Small nit: ensure quantization profile for runtime v5.1 is pinned in dedicated pools to avoid float->int regression. If not present, postpone unpin.
Marta: Confirmed quant profile is baked for dedicated. Only console schema is the gating doc we discussed.
Jules: If we hit any of the rollback triggers, plan is: immediate router/API rollback to previous pinned variants, then runtime revert if evictions persist. Console rollback is manual (schema rollback).
Ben: Who's owning the post-mortem if we need rollback? Suggest runtime team lead + release owner.
Sam: I'll own the post-mortem. Runtime lead (Priya) + Router (Jules) as co-authors.
Marta: Merging schema PR now would reduce risk. I'll target merge in 20m.
Sam: Cool. Final sign-off: @deploy-bot proceed with runtime canary per schedule. Everyone, monitor those four hooks. :thumbsup: :shipit:
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] acknowledged. Next status update posted in thread at t+10m and on the release ticket.
Ben: Linking release notes PR for visibility: https://git/repo/pulls/214 — includes consumer-facing changes and rollback instructions.
Sam: Thanks — I'll post a short summary for the ops channel once we're at 25% and stable.
Marta: Will follow up with console merge confirmation.
Priya: On standby to scale runtime back if needed.
Jules: Watching dashboards.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] thread closed for updates until first canary completes. Use /release override if emergency.
